environment: Python 3.12.14, Linux. Full pipeline run in a clean copy of the numerical distribution with 13 hash-verified public CMS and Census inputs staged in the download cache. The PRICE and supported-fitting stages fetched their upstream inputs.
additional_checks: Lewisham source PDF SHA-256 and four transcribed rows verified; raster OCR separately matched all four rows.
Main trust distribution recalculated from both wait columns; 83 complete pairs, 13 shorter, 21 equal, 49 longer; both tails retained.
Full manuscript rebuilt with pdfLaTeX. New figure and evidence map use embedded Arial and were visually inspected.

The signed welfare bound agreed with exhaustive endpoint enumeration for all 27 sign patterns in a three-group check. Linked-pool responses agreed with nonlinear equilibrium changes under both technologies to within 4e-11.
I-PLAN plan effects from the four independently randomized arms: +1.50 logged hours/day without the prompt and -1.60 with it. Equal-weight contrast -0.05, unadjusted interaction -3.10.

Independent enumeration of the incumbent valuation endpoints gave H bounds [0.0488640047, 0.9519346418] at eta=0.50 and [-0.0035048464, 0.8393610815] at eta=0.40. The lower gap crosses zero at 0.4066926165.
The figure and numerical results are distributed with editable sources. The paper baseline command was recovered verbatim using both Poppler and PyMuPDF.
